The role applies lean thinking to simplify work, improve flow, reduce waste, and ensure future-state solutions enable effective enterprise transformation. Highlights of your role Define detailed business processes and requirements for ERP manufacturing functionality, including picking, fabrication, assembly, material movement, quality, labor, and packaging. Apply lean principles to evaluate current and future-state processes, identify waste, improve flow, and align system design with efficient manufacturing execution. Lead cross-functional requirements gathering using interviews, workshops, value stream mapping and shop-floor observation. Translate manufacturing needs into clear business requirements, process flows, user experience expectations, test scenarios, training needs, and governance standards. Partner with operations, engineering, IT, business process owners, and site stakeholders to align future-state processes with practical production requirements and lean operating practices. Guide workstation and production execution design needs, including operator interfaces, material visibility, pick lists, work order status, displays, and workflow requirements. Identify requirements for constraints, part re-ordering, labor distribution, training tracking, performance KPIs, and production visibility. Use structured problem-solving methods to define root causes, evaluate process gaps, and recommend practical system-enabled improvements. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence diverse groups across manufacturing, engineering, operations, IT, and leadership. Strong facilitation, presentation, communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder influence skills. Ability to mentor, coach, and support team members by sharing knowledge, building capability, and helping others develop. Creative thinker and change agent with the ability to challenge current processes and guide adoption of new ways of working. Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute to small and large project efforts in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Strong business acumen with the ability to convert detailed information into insights, recommendations, and business impact. Self-motivated, adaptable, and committed to team success, continuous learning, and practical solution development.
